_provenance: Real, publicly-confirmed contact ROUTES for companies already in the database.
What these are: departments that demonstrably exist at these companies, each
evidenced by an official page on the company's own website whose existence was
confirmed by search. They give an Account Manager the exact page to use.
Every entry is contact_kind DEPARTMENT_ROUTE: an official department route, never
a named person. The database stores that distinction as a column rather than as a
naming convention, so nothing here can be presented as somebody to ask for by name.
What these are NOT: named individuals, and not email addresses. No address could
be obtained for any of these companies from this environment - the pages exist but
cannot be fetched (egress blocked), and search results do not expose the
addresses on them. Every entry therefore carries email_status UNKNOWN, which is
the honest answer and is what the UI displays.
Deliberately excluded: contact-data brokers (RocketReach, TheOrg and similar).
Those sites did surface named individuals, but their product is aggregated
personal contact data, and citing them as provenance would breach the rule that
only publicly available professional information from legitimate sources is used.
Also deliberately excluded: an Investor Relations contact found on an official
page. IR has no relationship to event spending, and collecting contacts with no
logical link to the opportunity is forbidden.
